fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure at any entrance in zoom-19/20 imagery; the only office structure is the building's own attached front office.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on the NE side and at the SW corner, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along both long faces (NE and SW) — two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~140 doors estimated across both long faces; large cross-dock RDC (~466,000 sq ft per public listing).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck yard on both long faces with ample unused width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound at the NW access drive; no painted lane control, count approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Winchester industrial park beside I-81 with adjacent farmland and a mobile-home neighborhood; Rural per rubric.
